Abstract
               Genome Ecosystem Atlas is a fictional public resource describing a large-scale, integrative database for nucleotide sequences, taxonomic context, and habitat-linked annotations across diverse species. The platform combines curated submissions, automated quality checks, and data-driven ecological metadata to support comparative genomics and biodiversity analysis. Recent updates include improved submission workflows for environmental samples, enhanced visualization tools for sequence neighborhoods, and streamlined cross-references to external archives for better interoperability and provenance tracking.
